newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Eagle buying TAC Melbourne hotel.
newsitem.headline: Great Eagle buying TAC Melbourne hotel.

text.p: Great Eagle Holdings Ltd was purchasing a hotel complex in Melbourne, Australia, from insurer Transport Accident Commission (TAC), a company official said on Monday.
The company was in the process of acquiring the 365-room Sheraton Tower Southgate Hotel in Melbourne for A$119 million, said Great Eagle public relations manager Winnie Wong.
The hotel complex includes two office blocks and a shopping arcade, she said.
Wong would not say whether the transaction had been completed or whether the company was seeking to acquire more assets in Australia.
No other details were to be released at this time, she said.
As at end-September 1995, the latest balance sheet available, Great Eagle had total assets of HK$25.44 billion and shareholders' funds of HK$15.86 billion.
TAC is a Victorian State Government-owned insurer.
